policies.name: LC-Lookup-Backend-Token
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<LookupCache continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="LC-Lookup-Backend-Token">
  <DisplayName>LC-Lookup-Backend-Token</DisplayName>
  <CacheResource>backend-token-cache</CacheResource>
  <AssignTo>backend.access_token</AssignTo>
  <CacheKey>
    <Prefix>backend-auth</Prefix>
    <KeyFragment ref="backend.token.cacheKey"/>
  </CacheKey>
</LookupCache>

policies.name: KVM-Get-Backend-Login-Credentials
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<KeyValueMapOperations continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="KVM-Get-Backend-Login-Credentials" mapIdentifier=" infath-out-socpa">
  <DisplayName>KVM-Get-Backend-Login-Credentials</DisplayName>
  <Properties/>
  <Get assignTo="private.backend.basicAuth" index="1">
    <Key>
      <Parameter>basicAuthBase64</Parameter>
    </Key>
  </Get>
  <Get assignTo="private.backend.username" index="1">
    <Key>
      <Parameter>username</Parameter>
    </Key>
  </Get>
  <Get assignTo="private.backend.password" index="1">
    <Key>
      <Parameter>password</Parameter>
    </Key>
  </Get>
  <Scope>environment</Scope>
</KeyValueMapOperations>

policies.name: AM-Build-Backend-Login-Request
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Build-Backend-Login-Request">
  <DisplayName>AM-Build-Backend-Login-Request</DisplayName>
  <Properties/>
  <AssignTo createNew="true" type="request">backend.login.request</AssignTo>
  <Set>
    <Verb>POST</Verb>
    <Headers>
      <Header name="Authorization">Basic {private.backend.basicAuth}</Header>
    </Headers>
    <Payload contentType="application/json">
        {
            "username": "{private.backend.username}",
            "Userpassword": "{private.backend.password}"
        }
        </Payload>
  </Set>
  <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: SC-Call-Backend-Login
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<ServiceCallout continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="SC-Call-Backend-Login">
  <DisplayName>SC-Call-Backend-Login</DisplayName>
  <Properties/>
  <Request clearPayload="true">backend.login.request</Request>
  <Response>backend.login.response</Response>
  <HTTPTargetConnection>
    <Properties/>
    <URL>https://service.socpa.org.sa/api/security</URL>
  </HTTPTargetConnection>
  <SSLInfo>
    <Enabled>true</Enabled>
  </SSLInfo>
</ServiceCallout>

policies.name: EV-Extract-Backend-Token
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<ExtractVariables continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="EV-Extract-Backend-Token">
  <DisplayName>EV-Extract-Backend-Token</DisplayName>
  <Properties/>
  <Source>backend.login.response</Source>
  <JSONPayload>
    <Variable name="backend.access_token" type="string">
      <JSONPath>$.token</JSONPath>
    </Variable>
    <Variable name="backend.expires_in" type="string">
      <JSONPath>$.expires_in</JSONPath>
    </Variable>
  </JSONPayload>
</ExtractVariables>

policies.name: JS-Calculate-Backend-Token-TTL
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<Javascript continueOnError="false" enabled="true" timeLimit="200" name="JS-Calculate-Backend-Token-TTL">
  <DisplayName>JS-Calculate-Backend-Token-TTL</DisplayName>
  <Properties/>
  <ResourceURL>jsc://calculate-backend-token-c.js</ResourceURL>
</Javascript>

policies.name: PC-Cache-Backend-Token
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<PopulateCache continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="PC-Cache-Backend-Token">
  <DisplayName>PC-Cache-Backend-Token</DisplayName>
  <CacheResource>backend-token-cache</CacheResource>
  <Source>backend.access_token</Source>
  <CacheKey>
    <Prefix>backend-auth</Prefix>
    <KeyFragment ref="backend.token.cacheKey"/>
  </CacheKey>
  <ExpirySettings>
    <TimeoutInSeconds ref="backend.token.ttl"/>
  </ExpirySettings>
</PopulateCache>
